SHCDESE-WORKAROUND(2.7.1-projectile-slot-view): SHCDESE 2.7.1 still exposes an invalid projectile range. Native RVA 0xA1350 initializes slots 0..5999 and stores exclusive bound 6000 at manager offset 0x04, while the public API exposes 10000 slots and admits ID 10000. The marked adapter detects both this sentinel-inclusive view and a corrected live-slot view by pointer identity, so it may remain after an upstream fix; remove it and its compatibility-only tests with a later planned release or when raising the minimum SE version.

SHCDESE 2.7.1 Tribe and Pitch queries also include reserved slot 0 and therefore shift query IDs. No workspace mod consumes those query APIs; direct tribe iteration was audited explicitly and pitch APIs are unused.
